contract.cold_start: No additional signal without an initial valid twelve-group seed
contract.drift: Three distinct consecutive absolute residuals >50bps trigger diagnosis only
contract.input_drift: Three distinct mean absolute training z-scores >3 trigger diagnosis only
contract.order: predict -> persist -> mature -> score original prediction -> update
contract.preprocessing: Initial training-only normalization and calibration stay frozen
contract.risk: Research updates cannot change account strategy, sizing, exits or permissions
contract.same_timestamp: Persist all predictions before processing labels at that timestamp
contract.seed: CP12 B training/calibration, frozen before the protected window
contract.window: Most recent 128 distinct matured event groups; full receipts remain retained

limitations: Historical causal simulation is not a prospective trading run
Multiple arm scores are not independent experiences
Drift diagnoses cannot promote, reset losses or mutate account strategy
